response.justification: Bogdan has extensive software development experience (15+ years) and demonstrates strong technical leadership through mentoring, organizing workshops, and leading open-source projects. However, his experience in developer tools, build systems, and testing infrastructure is limited to AI-agent infrastructure and CI/CD setup, with no clear evidence of mobile-platform knowledge or organizational change leadership. His recent roles focus more on full-stack engineering rather than people management.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience with diverse tech stacks (JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, Node.js, etc.).
Strong technical leadership demonstrated through mentoring, organizing workshops, and leading open-source projects.
Experience with CI/CD, developer tooling (MCP, code generators), and system design for scalable applications.
concerns: Limited direct experience in developer tools, build systems, or testing infrastructure for mobile platforms.
No clear evidence of people management experience in a mid-to-senior leadership role (only team leads or mentoring).
Recent roles emphasize full-stack engineering over strategic roadmap planning or organizational change leadership.
